lines.l: I try to laugh about it, hiding the tears in my eyes, cause boys, don't cry, boys, don't cry.
I'll break down at your feet and pay forgiveness, plead with you, but I know that it's too late and now there's nothing I can't do.
So I try to laugh about it, cover it all up with lies
I try to laugh about it, hide in the tears in my eyes
I would tell you that I loved you if I thought that you would stay
But I know that it's no use that you've already gone away
Thought that you need every moment
But now I would do most anything to get you back by my side
But I just keep on laughing, hiding my jeans in my eyes
